items.note: Uses the placeholder [Landlord's Name] instead of naming Ms. Alvarez.
Uses the placeholder [address/unit number] instead of Apartment 4B.
Uses the placeholder [on date / a few days ago] instead of October 2.
Doesn't mention the October 3 phone call or that nobody responded.
Only says 'temperatures dropping'. It never says overnight lows are in the 40s °F.
Asks for a repair 'as soon as possible', not within 48 hours.
Doesn't cite lease section 12 or the landlord's duty to provide heat. It only offers to add a lease reference later.
The tone is polite but not firm. It has no deadline, no note of the ignored call and no lease duty, and reads as a gentle request.
It doesn't threaten to withhold rent.
The email itself is roughly 140 words, under the limit. The tips after it are outside the letter.
